Counsel for Applicant :- Akhtar Husain
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1 . A counter affidavit has been filed on behalf of the State, which is taken on record.

2. Heard Sri Rizwanul Hasan Ansari, Advoicate holding brief of Sri Akhtar Hussain, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Sharad Kumar Verma, learned Addl. Government Advocate, and perused the record.
3. By means of the instant application the applicant Dinesh Verma, seeks bail in Case Crime No. 560 of 2022, under sections 419,420,467,468 and 471, I.P.C., P.S. Palia, District Kheri.

4. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 27.09.2019 against 14 persons including the applicant stating that co-accused Kapil Verma was the authorized Gold Valuer of the Bank and he gave false reports regarding gold kept by the other accused persons as surety for Dinesh Verma vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Lko.

5. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail-application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent.
He has falsely been implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.

It has further been stated in the affidavit that Kapil Verma, who is said to have submitted false Gold Valuer report, has been granted bail by means of order dated 31.05.2023 passed by this Court in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 7335 of 2023.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 7335 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: One of the co-accused Deepak Dixit, who is also a borrower of gold loan has been granted bail by this Court by means of order dated 30.06.2023 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 8130 of 2023.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 8130 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 6. The State has filed a counter affidavit annexing therewith copy of relevant documents collected during investigation and copy of chargesheet.

7. Having considered the facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the case set-up against the applicant is at par with the case set up against the co-accused Deepak Dixit,
without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail on the ground of parity.
8. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.
(Subhash Vidyarthi, J.) Order Date :- 21.7.2023
